runtime.execution: Asyncio KimiSoul with in-repo Kosong streaming/tool scheduler and KAOS backend; background Bash detached worker, background agents in current event loop
runtime.service_boundary: Owns local commands/task workers/context files; consumes model/MCP/KAOS services. Persisted task spec is not shared compute control plane.

summary: Python coding harness with programmable prompt-flow graphs, schema tools, root-managed background jobs and truly restored subagents, rotating compaction history and wire events.

inspection.scope: Entry run/cancel wiring, soul phases, actual Kosong generation and Kimi provider SDK, tool hooks/dispatch/results, foreground/background custody, child restore/model/role guards, compaction/rotation, wire logger, model reload, feedback and tests.
inspection.limits: Source read only, reference not executed. Alternative provider/remote KAOS transports, all media/search/question executors, ACP/web UI, flow parser and full hook scheduler not exhaustively traced. Source only, no reference run.

actions.name: ReadFile / ReadMediaFile / Glob / Grep
actions.lifecycle: awaited KAOS reads; default schemas, not every media/search executor traced
actions.authority: Model; file tools plus configurable workspace scope.

actions.name: WriteFile / StrReplaceFile
actions.lifecycle: awaited; plan mode restricts writes and approval policy applies
actions.authority: Model; yolo/afk autoapprove, plan protections remain.

actions.name: Shell
actions.output: foreground clipped output/exit or task ID/full log pointer
actions.lifecycle: foreground fresh shell; background detached worker with control store
actions.authority: Model; approval unless autoapproved; local host authority.

actions.name: TaskList / TaskOutput / TaskStop
actions.lifecycle: root-only; background process control or asyncio agent cancellation
actions.authority: Root model; no child background-management access.

actions.name: Agent
actions.lifecycle: new or truly context-restored child; simultaneous resume forbidden; background asyncio
actions.authority: Model root; per-child alias/spec; role limits and saved launch data.

actions.name: SetTodoList / AskUserQuestion
actions.output: displayed task state or user answer
actions.lifecycle: default catalog; individual executors not deeply traced
actions.authority: Model; afk behavior/authority set by runtime.

actions.name: EnterPlanMode / ExitPlanMode
actions.output: runtime plan mode/status and controlled plan file writes
actions.lifecycle: tool-execution mode changes; not redefining turn program
actions.authority: Model; default operations and file protections.

actions.name: SearchWeb / FetchURL
actions.lifecycle: consumed network services, catalog and native schemas inspected; full service implementation not audited

actions.name: SendDMail
actions.output: signal reverting future context with message
actions.lifecycle: installed only explicit custom agent catalog; rotates context but external file effects remain

actions.name: FlowRunner / /flow skill / ralph_loop
actions.input: graph begin/end/task/decision nodes and labelled edges, move cap
actions.lifecycle: same soul history across prompt stages; invalid decision retry not counted as valid move
actions.authority: Host/operator flow skill; model selects branches through <choice>.

actions.name: steer / run cancel event
actions.output: queued user injection/wire SteerInput or RunCancelled
actions.lifecycle: steer between steps and before stop; cancel awaits soul/futures
actions.authority: Operator/wire client; native model peer-message bus not provided.

actions.name: /compact [focus] / context checkpoint,revert
actions.output: summary+tail and active task reminder; rotated full previous context files
actions.lifecycle: compaction separately calls model; checkpoint rotates/rebuilds effective data
actions.authority: Operator/runtime; model file reads can access history as files, no dedicated repair transaction.

actions.name: /model / reload / session switch
actions.output: config save and same-session runtime reconstruction
actions.lifecycle: background work explicitly preserved; no refit pause/quiescence
actions.authority: Operator; program reload, not compiled executable handoff.

actions.name: /feedback
actions.input: feedback text under managed provider or GitHub fallback
actions.lifecycle: user prompt/HTTP submit; no captured-state bundle
actions.authority: Operator; no default model rageshake tool.

actions.name: custom agent YAML / native tool imports / hooks / MCP
actions.input: agent prompt/tool paths/subagent specs; hook command/callback; MCP config
actions.output: native tool descriptors/results and before-tool block
actions.lifecycle: runtime composition/deferred loading; hook execution around actions; no affected-workflow activation transaction traced
actions.authority: Program/operator defines extension, model may edit files but not hot-install full loop.

actions.name: WireFile.iter_records / Context.restore
actions.lifecycle: wire merged append and context rotation, malformed data may be skipped
actions.authority: Program/operator; not general model SQL audit API.

filesystem.detail: Native KAOS file/search/media/write/replace with plan/workspace checks; shell expands host access.

processes.detail: Fresh foreground shell kills direct child without reaping/group ownership; background separate worker has group TERM/KILL/wait and file output.

code_actions.detail: Shell general command execution and task-backed background code, not resident kernel.

persistent_kernel.detail: No resident notebook/Python namespace in inspected default tools, KAOS or background worker.

standing_database.detail: Persistent file task/context stores support standing work; no native general shared-DB query client.

workflow_programming.detail: FlowRunner actual graph prompt/decision transitions, serial stages with model choice; native tools/hooks/agent composition. Invalid choice may repeat without valid-move cap progressing.

multi_model.detail: Agent model alias override or saved effective/spec model clones child LLM.

live_collaboration.detail: Concurrent parent/children and TaskOutput feedback exist; resume forbidden while running, no send-to-running-colleague/peer bus in native catalog.

concurrent_work.detail: Tools start during model generation, background shell workers and in-process agent tasks with stable IDs.

steering_interrupt.detail: Between-step steers and cancel-and-await run/futures implemented; foreground shell direct-child kill, background status may mark killed before cleanup.

turn_redefinition.detail: Prompt-flow graphs and hook programs expressive; underlying soul step/continuation still host-defined, no model live replacement.

compaction.detail: Auto/manual custom focus summary, preserved tail, begin/end events, rotating original context file and active task snapshot.

context_repair.detail: Rotated normalized context files and checkpoint reversion support restoration; optional D-Mail conveys later state. No default model managed original-context repair transaction.

original_audit.detail: Merged wire JSONL and rotating contexts valuable; raw provider request/HTTP/chunk order and clipped foreground output omitted, recorder failures logged only.

audit_query.detail: Wire iter_records/Context.restore and ordinary ReadFile permit study of persisted normalized logs; no model DB audit tables.

hot_change.detail: /model reconstructs same session preserving background tasks; no general after-turn/affected-workflow change transaction.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Real saved child/context restore and runtime Reload are data continuity; detached Bash can persist, agents remain current asyncio tasks. Reload intentionally keeps work active rather than refit quiescence.

remote_services.detail: Provider SDK adapter, MCP client and KAOS boundary consume services; no shared fabric governor.

self_improvement.detail: Flow ralph/task graph plus editable files/hooks are useful search programs; no governed harness autoresearch/refit lifecycle traced.

complaints.detail: Operator /feedback attaches a few identifiers/version/OS/model, not model-issued full captured-state bead; no native complaint default.

authority.detail: Yolo/afk remove tool approvals; hooks/plan restrictions and root-only task access persist. Explore README prompt constraint not treated as physical readonly.

evaluation.detail: Mock soul/real storage resume test, real controlled sleep worker status test and compaction prompt oracle; not descendant custody/provider correctness.

time_order.detail: Checkpoints/task IDs/wire wall timestamps and awaited cancellation provide order primitives; merged events and early killed status not complete causal original audit.

evidence.claim: Default native action catalog and named subagents; Think/SendDMail disabled here.
Compaction/checkpoint/step/outcome/steer phases; D-Mail revert and next-step steering.
kosong.step receives current prompt/toolset/effective history and wire callbacks.
Step starts tools as calls complete during generation; cancels and awaits tracked futures on model failure/cancellation.
Actual provider.generate and streamed-part assembly/tool-call callback; normalized messages, not raw HTTP wire.
Native provider converts history/tools and uses async OpenAI SDK stream/raw-response API.
PreToolUse hook may block; native tool coroutine awaited and cancellation propagated.
Awaits tool results then grows history and stops on no calls/rejection/repetition.
Normalized assistant/tool context appended after results complete.
Steer queue injects follow-up user messages; /btw intercepted elsewhere.
Shell command/timeout/background/description parameter contract.
Shell approval and bounded output builder with success/error exit interpretation.
Fresh shell via KAOS, timeout only wraps reading pipes; cancellation/timeout calls process.kill, no wait there.
Local process.kill kills direct child without awaiting reap or descendants.
Foreground local subprocess has no new process session/group.
Bash task worker is detached process with new OS session.
Worker control loop sends group TERM then KILL after grace.
Background shell stdout/stderr file and process group; actual wait/timeout/TERM/KILL/reap.
Background agents instead asyncio tasks in current parent; persistent task spec and explicit agent/model/prompt.
TaskStop agent marks killed before task cancellation cleanup; Bash sends persisted control and best-effort signal.
TaskList/TaskOutput/TaskStop schemas, background access root-only.
TaskOutput can block with timeout then returns status, preview path/size and full log ReadFile hint.
Real child context restore and persisted prompt reuse; prompt snapshot and new soul.
Cloned child LLM model override/effective/spec fallback.
Reject simultaneous resume, mark running_background before async dispatch and retain launch-model metadata.
Revert/clear rotate old file then reconstruct/clear effective messages; normalized append JSONL.
Summary via separate no-tools model step, excludes thinking and returns summary plus preserved tail.
Preserves last configured user-message groups and serializes prior history for summary.
Compaction emits begin, rotates/clears context, writes summary/checkpoint and retains active task snapshot.
Wire recorder consumes merged complete-message queue; recorder flush failure only logged.
JSONL timestamps/protocol metadata, malformed records skipped, append not fsync transaction.
Output builder clips chars and per-line size before native result/wire record.
FlowRunner node/decision execution, bounded valid moves, invalid decision repeats same node.
Model operator command saves config then reloads same session.
Reload/vis/web explicitly preserve background tasks rather than stopping them; ordinary exit shuts down.
Operator feedback includes session ID/text/version/OS/model; no state bundle/native model complaint.
Afk or yolo implies automatic tool approval.
Autoapproval path bypasses operator request after trace metadata setup.
KAOS file path validation/plan protection and append/overwrite preparation.
Multiple old/new edits prepared and no-op rejected before write approval.
MCP request approval, client call timeout and converts is_error results.
Mock soul but real runner/store/context; same ID resumes and assistant context accumulates.
Real sleep worker controlled stop; checks stored terminal status/reason, not descendants separately.
Compaction custom focus included in model prompt; no semantic preservation oracle.
Optional SendDMail implemented checkpoint signal, disabled default catalog.
Run wrapper races cancel event, cancels and awaits soul; wire recorder/notification lifecycle.

tests.oracle: Mock soul/provider but actual runner/context/store verifies same ID, growing assistant history, type preservation and active-instance rejection.
Real sleep worker writes terminal killed/timeout status and reason; no independently probed surviving descendants.
Deterministic custom instruction/tail assertions; no semantic original recovery or vendor response oracle.

strengths: First-class task output/path/stop identity and child context restore.
Flow graph branching with model choice and same conversation.
Compaction rotates previous context and reinjects active work snapshot.
limits: Alternative provider/remote KAOS transports, all media/search/question executors, ACP/web UI, flow parser and full hook scheduler not exhaustively traced. Source only, no reference run.
arconaut_questions: Can foreground commands use the stronger background process-group/reap contract?
Can live child messages/steers exist without waiting for idle resume?
Can original capture retain raw output/provider boundaries before presentation merging and clipping?
Can after-workflow hot change and quiescent refit separate from keep-running runtime reload?
